preconditions.description: The number of rows in the first map is between 1 and 2000.
The number of columns in the first map is between 1 and 200.
The number of columns in the first map is less than or equal to the number of rows in the first map.

preconditions.expression: all(len(row) == M for row in first_map)
preconditions.description: Each row in the first map has exactly M characters.

preconditions.expression: all(len(row) == N for row in second_map)
preconditions.description: Each row in the second map has exactly N characters.

preconditions.expression: all('a' <= char <= 'z' for row in first_map for char in row)
preconditions.description: All characters in the first map are lower-case Latin letters.

preconditions.expression: all('a' <= char <= 'z' for row in second_map for char in row)
preconditions.description: All characters in the second map are lower-case Latin letters.

postconditions.description: The row index i of the M × M section in the first map is between 1 and N - M + 1.
The column index j of the M × M section in the second map is between 1 and N - M + 1.

postconditions.expression: all(first_map[i + k - 1][j - 1] == second_map[k - 1][j - 1] for k in range(1, M + 1))
postconditions.description: The M × M section starting at row i in the first map is identical to the M × M section starting at column j in the second map.
